judge.rationale: The core cytotoxic and myeloid contributors (including GNLY, NKG7, GZMA/GZMB, CD8B, CST3, S100A12, FCN1, LYZ, CD14, and HLA-DRB1) recur with comparable cell-identity roles, but B–D add substantial B-cell, erythroid, platelet, mouse/technical, and additional lineage markers largely absent from A, so roughly one-half to three-quarters of the complete molecular content is shared and the incomplete-coverage ceiling of 6 applies.
